summary: Bug NOT fixed. Paywall still displays $9.99 for the MONTHLY plan (both the large price card and 'SUBSCRIBE — $9.99' button). Root cause is server-side: RevenueCat's product pricing for pro.monthly is still $9.99 (amount_micros 9990000). The frontend code in /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx is correct — it explicitly selects currentOffering.monthly / '$rc_monthly' / packageType 'MONTHLY' and renders pkg.product.priceString. The reported RevenueCat product-price update to $5.00 via the integration proxy did NOT actually persist on RevenueCat's side.

critical.endpoint: RevenueCat integration proxy (product price upsert for $rc_monthly / pro.monthly)
critical.issue: The POST to $INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL/internal/revenuecat/projects/1d06066f-.../products with {price:5.00, amount_micros:5000000} did NOT update the live price. RevenueCat GET rcbilling/v1/.../products?id=pro.monthly returns current_price.amount_micros=9990000 ($9.99). Main agent must re-run the upsert (or update via the RC dashboard test-store product pricing) and re-verify with the RC API before retesting the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows '$9.99' in MONTHLY price card and 'SUBSCRIBE — $9.99' button. Expected $5.00. Root cause is RC-side pricing, not the RN component. File: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:23,68,87,104.

integration_issues.issue: The frontend reads the priceString directly from RevenueCat's Offerings/rcbilling response. Any hardcoded fallback '$5.00' in code is only used when pkg is undefined — it is NOT used here because offerings load successfully and the real (wrong) price $9.99 is returned. Fixing this in the RN code (e.g. hardcoding $5.00) would mask the real store-side pricing bug and break real purchases.

react_native_issues.issue: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'textShadow'. 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking, but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Re-run the RevenueCat integration-proxy price upsert for $rc_monthly to $5.00 and VERIFY by curling https://api.revenuecat.com/rcbilling/v1/.../products?id=pro.monthly (or the internal proxy status endpoint) that current_price.amount_micros == 5000000 BEFORE claiming the bug is fixed.

If the proxy upsert is idempotent but not effective, try alternative payloads: some price updates in RC create a new price record (note price_id 'prc85efb12e66a94bd7b212' in the current response) instead of mutating the old one — you may need to attach the new price to the product/package or update the offering.
After RC returns $5.00, retest the paywall UI (Profile tab → MANAGE PREMIUM → verify MONTHLY card + SUBSCRIBE button both show $5.00).
Do NOT hardcode $5.00 in paywall.tsx — the current code correctly reads from RC; the fix belongs on the RevenueCat side.
Also update pro.annual price if annual pricing is expected to change ($79.99 was returned; per memory/revenuecat.md that is intentional and not in-app, so likely no action).
critical_code_review_comments: paywall.tsx line 23: fallback 'const price = pkg?.product.priceString || "$5.00"' is only used when pkg is nullish. Since offerings load, pkg is defined and this fallback is a no-op. Keep it, but it should not be relied on for the fix.
revenuecat.tsx correctly picks the Test Store API key on web/DEV; init and offerings query look fine — no code changes required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduction: login athlete@test.com / TestPass123! → Profile (ME) tab → tap [data-testid=open-paywall-profile] → observe MONTHLY $9.99 and SUBSCRIBE — $9.99. Verification of fix requires the RevenueCat API for pro.monthly to return current_price.amount_micros=5000000. The network call to watch is GET https://api.revenuecat.com/rcbilling/v1/subscribers/.../products?id=pro.monthly&id=pro.annual.
rca_of_issue: The RevenueCat Web/Test-Store Offerings API (https://api.revenuecat.com/v1/subscribers/{id}/offerings + https://api.revenuecat.com/rcbilling/v1/subscribers/{id}/products?id=pro.monthly) returns current_price.amount_micros=9990000 ($9.99) for pro.monthly. The frontend paywall renders exactly this priceString. The main agent's fix (explicitly selecting currentOffering.monthly instead of availablePackages[0]) does not matter because ALL monthly packages point to the same pro.monthly product which is still $9.99 in RevenueCat. The real bug is that the integration-proxy price update to $5.00 either never applied or did not propagate to the Test Store price record used by the SDK. Mitigation: main agent must re-issue the RC product/price update, confirm via the RC API, then retest the UI.
